title: Moon Hub
features:
🌑 Advance HUB - v1.0.0 Release

✅ AUTO FARM • Select world and enemy to farm. • Auto target nearest enemy and teleport into range. • Live status panel (map, enemy, target, distance).

✅ AUTO GLOBAL BOSS • Auto detect and teleport to Global Bosses. • Smart Queue: Waits for Trial/Fruit collection before hunting. • Ignore List: Select specific bosses to skip. • Auto return to previous map & save position after kill.

✅ GAMEMODES - TRIAL • Auto join Trial Easy at exact times (15 and 45). • Auto pause/resume Auto Farm when entering/leaving Trial. • Auto kill trial enemies (teleport to nearest). • Auto leave by wave or when time ends. • Optional teleport to a selected world after trial. • Optional save & restore player position after trial.

✅ GAMEMODES - RAID • Detects Raid via GUI or enemies. • Auto start and auto restart Raids. • Auto kill raid enemies (teleport to nearest). • Auto leave by wave or when time ends. • Detailed Raid status HUD (wave, time, modes).

✅ AUTO ROLL - GACHA & PASSIVES • Auto Open Stars: Select map and amount. • Auto Roll Ranks: Hero, Ninja, Haki, Clan. • Auto Roll Passives: With system to Lock specific traits. • Auto Roll Sword Passives: Rolls for equipped sword with Lock system. • Auto Roll Talents: Lock specific Ranks (F-A) or Stats.

✅ AUTO COLLECT FRUITS • Auto detect fruits across all maps. • Auto teleport to fruit map and collect. • Pauses Boss Hunt/Farm to collect and returns afterwards. • Tracks last fruit/map and total fruits collected.

✅ AUTO UPGRADES • Auto World Upgrades for selected worlds (Power/Damage/Coins). • Auto Trial Upgrades for selected boosts (Power/Damage/Coins/Range).

✅ PLAYER & MISC • Auto Rank Up when XP is enough. • Auto Equip Best: Pets, Swords, Heroes, Accessories, Gacha and Vault. • Redeem All Codes: Fetches latest codes from server. • Auto Expedition: Start, wait and claim (multi-map support). • Infinite Jump, Fly, HipHeight, Anti-AFK & AntiLag. • Customizable UI (Themes, Keybinds, HUD Titles).
